title: Plan to actual explainer
question: Which units missed plan outside tolerance this month, and what moved the result from plan to actual?
story: Actual landed {variance} against plan; {outside_n} units sit outside the 3% tolerance.
questions: Which units moved most against plan, and why?
Which units trail their peer median the most?

datasets.name: records
datasets.sql: SELECT o.record_key, o.entity_id, o.entity_label, o.priority_tier, o.`rank`, o.top_reasons, o.recommended_action, o.value, o.as_of_date, v.period, v.actual, v.plan, v.variance, v.tolerance, u.region, u.segment, u.channel FROM main.finance.unit_perf_out AS o JOIN main.finance.unit_perf_out__variance AS v ON v.unit = o.entity_id JOIN main.finance.units AS u ON u.unit_id = o.entity_id WHERE o.is_current AND o.change_source <> 'delete'

datasets.name: walk
datasets.sql: SELECT b.step, b.label, b.value, b.step_type FROM main.finance.unit_perf_out__bridge AS b

datasets.name: peers
datasets.sql: SELECT p.unit, u.unit_label, p.peer_group, p.metric, p.peer_median, p.gap, p.peer_median + p.gap AS unit_value, u.region, u.segment, u.channel FROM main.finance.unit_perf_out__peers AS p JOIN main.finance.units AS u ON u.unit_id = p.unit

datasets.name: comments
datasets.sql: SELECT c.unit_id, u.unit_label, c.period, c.author, c.note AS remark, c.reason, u.region, u.segment, u.channel FROM main.finance.variance_comments AS c JOIN main.finance.units AS u ON u.unit_id = c.unit_id

kpis.label: Units outside tolerance
kpis.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(variance) > tolerance THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

charts.title: Plan to actual
charts.hint: Each step adds up from plan to actual.
charts.so_what: The biggest step is where to look first; click it to see the units behind it.

charts.title: Each unit against its peer median
charts.hint: Above the line beats peers; below it trails them.
charts.so_what: Units far below their peers need a plan, not only an explanation.

charts.title: What moved the result
charts.hint: Each driver step of the bridge, the widest swing first.
charts.so_what: Ask the owner of the top driver to confirm it before the month closes.

y.label: Down
y.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN step_type = 'driver' AND value < 0 THEN value ELSE 0 END)

y.label: Up
y.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN step_type = 'driver' AND value > 0 THEN value ELSE 0 END)

tables.title: Gap to the peer median
tables.hint: Each unit against the median of its peer group.
tables.so_what: The widest gaps are the units to compare with their best peer.

tables.title: What the owners said
tables.hint: Comments the unit owners left on this month's variance.
tables.so_what: A reason that repeats across units points at a plan change, not a miss.

records.title: Units against plan
records.hint: Units from the latest run, the largest variance first. Tolerance is ±3%.
records.label: entity_label
